cards.why: The most expensive trap in the room. The XML is perfect — and it is still non-compliant. Under the DCTCE five-corner model an invoice is only 'issued' once it has travelled C1→C3→C4→C2 with simultaneous reporting to the FTA at C5. Emailing valid XML directly to your buyer reports nothing to anyone.

cards.title: SCANNED PDF INVOICE
cards.route: C1 → C2 direct (email)
cards.why: A scanned PDF, a paper original and an emailed image are NOT e-invoices. The UAE mandate requires a structured PINT AE XML payload. Filing this document constitutes a failure to issue a valid e-invoice.

cards.title: MISSING BUYER TRN

cards.title: DEPLOY P.R.O. CARD
cards.strap: Government & administrative payments, ring-fenced.
cards.body: Issue a dedicated P.R.O. card with merchant-category controls locked to government portals, immigration, licensing and utility payees. Spend outside the permitted categories is declined at authorisation — before it becomes a reconciliation problem.
cards.effect: IMMUNITY: your table can no longer incur the AED 5,000/month implementation penalty for the remainder of the simulation. +AED 25,000 capital.
cards.teaches: Controls applied at the point of sale beat controls applied at month-end.

cards.title: DEPLOY C-SUITE CARD
cards.strap: Executive travel and lifestyle, with a policy attached.
cards.body: Issue premium executive cards with travel privileges and a policy envelope configured centrally — limits, categories and approval thresholds set once in the web portal, enforced on every swipe.
cards.effect: +AED 30,000 capital. Unlocks one bonus executive travel transaction worth +AED 20,000 if played before the final 5 minutes.
cards.teaches: Premium benefits and spend governance are not a trade-off.

cards.title: SET DAILY TRANSACTION LIMIT
cards.strap: AED 10,000 per day. Set in seconds, from anywhere.
cards.body: Cap manual spending per card, per day, from the central web portal. No bank visit, no form, no waiting for a relationship manager to call back.
cards.effect: DAMPER: every penalty your table incurs from this point is capped at AED 10,000, regardless of size. +AED 15,000 capital.
cards.teaches: The cheapest risk control is the one you can change in real time.

cards.title: AI-OCR RECEIPT MATCHING
cards.strap: The receipt chase, deleted.
cards.body: Capture the receipt at the moment of spend. AI-driven optical character recognition reads it, auto-matches it to the settled transaction, and posts it to the ledger without a human touching a spreadsheet.
cards.effect: AUTOMATION: instantly files every remaining VALID invoice your table holds at full value, and safely quarantines every INVALID one with zero penalty. Play it, and the machine does not make the mistakes you were about to make.
cards.teaches: This is the single most important card in the deck, and the closing argument of the entire event.

cards.title: CONSOLIDATE VIRTUAL IBANs
cards.strap: One dashboard. Every entity.
cards.body: Assign a virtual IBAN per entity, per department or per project, all reporting into one central portal with 360-degree visibility across the group.
cards.effect: One-time: file ONE foreign invoice you are holding without trading it — group consolidation lets you recognise it internally. +AED 20,000 capital.
cards.teaches: Multi-entity groups fail compliance at the seams between entities.

cards.title: CONTINUOUS LEDGER CLOSE
cards.strap: The month-end that never happens.
cards.body: Transactions, receipts and approvals reconcile continuously rather than in a five-day scramble after the period ends. The ledger is always closed, because it is never open.
cards.effect: MULTIPLIER: all capital your table earns in the final 5 minutes of the simulation is doubled.
cards.teaches: Real-time reporting regimes are incompatible with retrospective bookkeeping.

cards.title: CONSOLIDATE ENTITY
cards.strap: Alliance card · requires one other table to agree
cards.body: Two group entities merge their reporting for a single filing window. Both tables present this card together at the ASP Station.
cards.effect: Both tables immediately file every foreign invoice they hold belonging to the other. Both gain +AED 40,000. Can only be played once per table.

cards.title: WPS PAYROLL SYNC
cards.strap: Wage Protection System · play alone or in a trade
cards.body: Synchronise payroll disbursement with the Wage Protection System and settle salaries to employee cards in one instruction.
cards.effect: +AED 35,000 capital. Immunises your table against the 'Payroll Shock' market event if the facilitator triggers it.

cards.title: ASP FAST-TRACK
cards.strap: Alliance card · requires one other table to agree
cards.body: Pre-agreed interoperability between two Accredited Service Providers. The trade clears without either party walking to the station.
cards.effect: Validate one card trade from your seat — no queue, no walk. Both tables save the time and gain +AED 10,000 each.

cards.title: MUTUAL RECOGNITION PACT
cards.strap: Alliance card · requires one other table to agree
cards.body: Two counterparties formally recognise each other's compliance posture, unlocking preferential settlement terms.
cards.effect: The next trade between these two tables pays DOUBLE the standard network bonus to both sides. Playable once per pairing.
